id: 05_Safety Officer Interview Questions & Answers for Gulf Countries (Saudi Arabia) S
title: 安全员面试问答：气体、作业许可与受限空间
source_doc: course/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/05_Safety Officer Interview Questions & Answers for Gulf Countries (Saudi Arabia) S.md
author_source: project/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/05_Safety Officer Interview Questions & Answers for Gulf Countries (Saudi Arabia) S/src.py

points.K9: 立即威胁生命和健康浓度IDLH
points.K13: 美国消防协会704危险菱形
points.K23: 人工开挖超过1.2米的许可

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着红色安全帽站在白板前招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears a red hard hat, stands in front of a blank whiteboard and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 欢迎回来！今天讲一场真实面试。
overlay: 安全员面试问答：气体、作业许可与受限空间

shots.scene: 沙漠边的石化厂剪影，旁边一个飞机图标
shots.prompt_en: A silhouette of a petrochemical plant at the edge of a desert with a small airplane icon above it. No people.
shots.narration: 第一次去海湾国家当安全员时被问的题。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴着安全帽，坐在面试桌前，对面是老周
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a hard hat sits at an interview desk facing the older man.
shots.narration: 阿杰要去海外石化厂面试。

shots.scene: 老周翻开一叠空白问题卡
shots.prompt_en: The older man flips open a stack of blank question cards.
shots.narration: 面试官一题接一题地问。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板上写下一个问号，旁边安全帽图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot draws a question mark next to a hard hat icon on the whiteboard.
shots.narration: 第一题：安全员的职责是什么？

shots.scene: 阿杰向老周汇报，老周点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reports to the older man, who nods, holding a blank folder.
shots.narration: 一，向管理层提供健康安全建议。

shots.scene: 阿杰在现场巡查，拿着空白检查表
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks around a plant site with a blank checklist, watching workers.
shots.narration: 二，监督现场作业是否守规定。

shots.scene: 阿杰在班前给工人做安全讲话
shots.prompt_en: The young male student gives a short pre-shift safety talk to a small group of workers in hard hats.
shots.narration: 三，通过班前安全讲话提高意识。

shots.scene: 放大镜图标找出危害，旁边对策卡
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass icon finds a hazard triangle, and a blank control card appears beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 四，识别危害，提出控制措施。

shots.scene: 培训、会议、检查、审核四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a training class, a meeting table, a checklist and an audit clipboard. No people.
shots.narration: 五，组织培训、会议、检查和审核。

shots.scene: 一叠空白文件：分析表、规程、计划、手册
shots.prompt_en: A stack of blank documents: an analysis sheet, a procedure, a plan, a rescue plan and a manual. No people.
shots.narration: 六，参与编制JSA、SOP和各类计划。

shots.scene: 放大镜对准事故示意图
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over a simple accident diagram. No people.
shots.narration: 七，参与事故调查和安全审核。

shots.scene: 黄绿色气团图标，旁边骷髅和火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: A yellowish gas cloud icon with a skull pictogram and a flame pictogram beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 硫化氢：有毒、易燃的气体。

shots.scene: 鼻子图标旁一个臭鸡蛋图标
shots.prompt_en: A nose icon next to a cartoon rotten egg with stink lines. No people.
shots.narration: 浓度1ppm时，闻起来像臭鸡蛋。

shots.scene: 无色气体沉在地面低处
shots.prompt_en: A clear colorless gas outline sinking and pooling along the ground below a pipe. No people.
shots.narration: 它无色，比空气重。

shots.scene: 两个数字牌：时钟和沙漏
shots.prompt_en: Two large blank number cards, one with a clock icon and one with an hourglass icon. No people.
shots.narration: TWA是10ppm，STEL是15ppm。

shots.scene: 两个透明气团图标，鼻子和眼睛图标都打问号
shots.prompt_en: Two clear gas cloud icons with a nose icon and an eye icon each marked with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 一氧化碳和二氧化碳，都无色无味。

shots.scene: 左边气团着火，右边气团不着火
shots.prompt_en: The left gas cloud catches fire while the right gas cloud stays unlit with a crossed flame. No people.
shots.narration: 一氧化碳可燃，二氧化碳不可燃。

shots.scene: 两个数字牌带红色感叹号
shots.prompt_en: Two large blank number cards with red exclamation marks. No people.
shots.narration: CO2超5000、CO超35ppm有害。

shots.scene: 一项作业被切成几段，每段一个警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A long task arrow is cut into segments, each with a small warning triangle and a blank control card. No people.
shots.narration: JSA：把作业拆成步骤，找危害定措施。

shots.scene: 四级台阶图标
shots.prompt_en: Four stairs, each with an icon: a pointing hand, a cut arrow, a magnifying glass and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: JSA四步。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰在空白分析表上逐行填写
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student fill in rows of a blank analysis sheet together.
shots.narration: 选作业，分步骤，找危害，定措施。

shots.scene: 三个原子模型：一个、两个、三个核内粒子
shots.prompt_en: Three simple atom models of hydrogen with one, two and three particles in the nucleus. No people.
shots.narration: 同位素：同一元素，质量数不同。

shots.scene: 三个原子中心都标同一个颜色
shots.prompt_en: The three atom models glow the same color around their single electron. No people.
shots.narration: 原子序数相同，质量数不同。

shots.scene: 时钟显示八小时，日历一周五天
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon showing a full working day and a calendar with five weekdays highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: TWA：每天8小时、每周40小时。

shots.scene: 工人图标在平稳的浓度线旁，绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A worker pictogram beside a steady concentration line with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 这样接触不产生不良健康影响。

shots.scene: 数字牌10ppm，旁边时钟
shots.prompt_en: A blank number card next to a clock icon showing a full shift. No people.
shots.narration: 比如TWA是10ppm，就能干8小时。

shots.scene: 沙漏图标旁一个浓度尖峰
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass icon next to a short sharp peak on a concentration line. No people.
shots.narration: STEL：最多15分钟接触的最高浓度。

shots.scene: 数字牌15ppm，旁边沙漏
shots.prompt_en: A blank number card next to an hourglass icon. No people.
shots.narration: 比如硫化氢15ppm，可干15分钟。

shots.section_title: 立即威胁生命和健康浓度IDLH
shots.scene: 红色警示区里的骷髅图标
shots.prompt_en: A red danger zone with a skull pictogram and a gas cloud. No people.
shots.narration: IDLH：立即威胁生命和健康的浓度。
overlay: 立即威胁生命和健康浓度IDLH

shots.section_title: 立即威胁生命和健康浓度IDLH
shots.scene: 欣欣刚开口，白板翻到下一页
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot starts to explain, then the whiteboard flips to a new page.
shots.narration: 原片只说到“工人一接触……”就跳题了。

shots.scene: 燃料表面冒出蒸气，靠近火花时一闪
shots.prompt_en: Vapor rises from a fuel surface; a spark nearby makes a brief flash. No people.
shots.narration: 闪点：燃料蒸气遇火源能点燃的最低温度。

shots.scene: 柴油桶图标旁温度计
shots.prompt_en: A diesel drum icon next to a thermometer icon. No people.
shots.narration: 柴油的闪点是54摄氏度。

shots.scene: 闪一下的火焰变成持续燃烧，旁边秒表
shots.prompt_en: A brief flash turns into a steady flame, a stopwatch beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 燃点：点燃后至少持续烧5秒的温度。

shots.scene: 柴油桶图标旁略高的温度计
shots.prompt_en: A diesel drum icon next to a slightly higher thermometer. No people.
shots.narration: 柴油的燃点是57摄氏度。

shots.scene: 浓度刻度条，中间一段亮起火焰
shots.prompt_en: A concentration scale bar from low to high with only the middle band glowing with flames. No people.
shots.narration: 爆炸下限和上限：能燃烧的浓度范围。

shots.scene: 刻度条左端标记下限
shots.prompt_en: A marker at the low end of the flame band on the scale bar. No people.
shots.narration: LEL：能燃烧的最低浓度，苯是1.2%。

shots.scene: 刻度条右端标记上限
shots.prompt_en: A marker at the high end of the flame band on the scale bar. No people.
shots.narration: UEL：能燃烧的最高浓度，苯是8%。

shots.scene: 两端之外的区域没有火焰
shots.prompt_en: The areas outside the flame band stay dark with crossed flame icons. No people.
shots.narration: 浓度在两者之间，才会燃烧爆炸。

shots.section_title: 美国消防协会704危险菱形
shots.scene: 四色菱形，红蓝黄白四格
shots.prompt_en: A diamond divided into four colored squares: red at the top, blue on the left, yellow on the right and white at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 美国消防协会704，化学品危险菱形。
overlay: 美国消防协会704危险菱形

shots.section_title: 美国消防协会704危险菱形
shots.scene: 红格火焰、蓝格心形、黄格爆炸、白格星号
shots.prompt_en: The diamond squares show icons: a flame in red, a heart in blue, a burst in yellow and a star in white. No people.
shots.narration: 红是火灾，蓝是健康，黄是反应性。

shots.section_title: 美国消防协会704危险菱形
shots.scene: 白格亮起
shots.prompt_en: The white bottom square of the diamond lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 白色表示特殊危害。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白许可证上签字交给阿杰
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs a blank permit form and hands it to the young male student.
shots.narration: 作业许可：授权人签发的书面授权。

shots.scene: 许可证上地点、时钟、盾牌三个图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank permit with three icons: a location pin, a clock and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 限定地点、限定时间，做好安全措施。

shots.scene: 八张许可证卡片，前四张亮起
shots.prompt_en: Eight blank permit cards in a row; the first four light up with icons: a wrench, a flame, a lightning bolt and a manhole. No people.
shots.narration: 各行业不同，原片列了八种。

shots.scene: 后四张亮起
shots.prompt_en: The last four permit cards light up with icons: a shovel, a radiation symbol, a crane hook and a water jet. No people.
shots.narration: 开挖、辐射、吊装、高压水射流。

shots.scene: 红色挂锁和空白挂牌挂在电闸上
shots.prompt_en: A red padlock and a blank tag hang on an isolation switch. No people.
shots.narration: 上锁挂牌：隔离能量，防止误操作。

shots.scene: 五级台阶图标
shots.prompt_en: Five stairs, each with an icon: a clipboard, an off switch, a padlock, a start button and an open padlock. No people.
shots.narration: LOTO五步。

shots.scene: 老李关闸上锁，再按启动按钮确认没反应
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches off a machine, locks the switch, then presses the start button to confirm nothing moves.
shots.narration: 准备、隔离、上锁挂牌、试启动。

shots.scene: 老李完工后取下挂锁
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the padlock and tag after finishing the work.
shots.narration: 作业完成后，再拆除。

shots.scene: 罐体只有一个小人孔
shots.prompt_en: A large tank with only one small manhole for entry. No people.
shots.narration: 受限空间：进出口受限的空间。

shots.scene: 罐内昏暗，空气流动箭头很少
shots.prompt_en: Inside the dark tank, only a few weak air flow arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 可能缺氧、照明不足、通风不良。

shots.scene: 五个图标：缺氧、富氧、风扇停转、灯泡暗、骷髅气团
shots.prompt_en: Five icons: a low oxygen gauge, a high oxygen gauge, a stopped fan, a dim bulb and a gas cloud with a skull. No people.
shots.narration: 危害：缺氧、富氧、通风照明差、毒气。

shots.scene: 许可证、挂锁、吹扫管、风机四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a permit form, a padlock, a purge hose and a ventilation blower. No people.
shots.narration: 要求：许可、上锁挂牌、吹扫、通风。

shots.scene: 照明灯、气体检测仪、人孔边监护人
shots.prompt_en: A work lamp, a gas detector and the security officer standing watch at the manhole.
shots.narration: 照明、气体检测、人孔监护人。

shots.scene: 培训课和救援计划图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a training class and a blank rescue plan with a tripod. No people.
shots.narration: 还要培训，要有救援计划。

shots.scene: 吊车吊着钢梁从带电设备上方经过
shots.prompt_en: A crane lifts a steel beam over energized electrical equipment with a lightning bolt icon. No people.
shots.narration: 关键吊装：在带电设备上方吊。

shots.scene: 吊车能力表，指针超过四分之三
shots.prompt_en: A crane capacity gauge with the needle past three quarters. No people.
shots.narration: 吊重超过额定能力的75%。

shots.scene: 两台吊车一起抬一根钢梁
shots.prompt_en: Two cranes lifting one steel beam together. No people.
shots.narration: 多台吊车抬吊，也是关键吊装。

shots.scene: 小研翻看一份空白的安全技术说明书，书架上一排文件夹
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads a blank safety data sheet in front of a rack of blank binders.
shots.narration: SDS：化学品理化性质和危害的详细资料。

shots.scene: 说明书分成十六个小格
shots.prompt_en: A blank data sheet divided into sixteen small numbered sections shown as dots. No people.
shots.narration: 健康、安全、环境信息，共16部分。

shots.section_title: 人工开挖超过1.2米的许可
shots.scene: 工人用铁锹挖坑，旁边深度标尺
shots.prompt_en: A worker digs a pit by hand with a shovel, a depth ruler beside the pit.
shots.narration: 人工开挖超过1.2米深，要办什么许可？
overlay: 人工开挖超过1.2米的许可

shots.section_title: 人工开挖超过1.2米的许可
shots.scene: 受限空间进入许可证图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: A blank permit card with a manhole icon lights up next to the pit. No people.
shots.narration: 原片答案：受限空间进入许可。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现安全帽和气团图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a floating hard hat icon and gas cloud icons.
shots.narration: 安全员职责，硫化氢、CO和CO2。

shots.scene: 时钟、沙漏、温度计、刻度条图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a clock, an hourglass, a thermometer and a concentration scale bar. No people.
shots.narration: TWA、STEL、闪点燃点、爆炸极限。

shots.scene: 菱形、许可证、挂锁图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a four-color diamond, a permit form and a padlock. No people.
shots.narration: 危险菱形、作业许可、上锁挂牌。

shots.scene: 罐体人孔、吊车、说明书图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a tank manhole, a crane and a data sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 受限空间、关键吊装和SDS。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起大拇指挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up and waves goodbye in front of the whiteboard.
shots.narration: 觉得有用就点个赞，下期见！
